description: Storefront-theme WooCommerce store running a sitewide 20% sale, a points loyalty program and a Google Analytics G- tag. 14-day returns paid by the customer. Native WooCommerce reviews (no review app).
notes: WordPress serves pages with a trailing slash; the fixture server answers both /shop and /shop/.
The Site Kit gtag.js <script src> loader is omitted on purpose so no page ever triggers a real network fetch; the inline gtag('config', 'G-7QF2KX9M3B') call is kept.

expected.announcement_bar: Summer Sale: 20% off everything, applied automatically. Free shipping on orders over $75.
